note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change, after a965ee38fb moved community stripping into chain members. RFC 9012 Section 11: "It MUST be possible to filter the Encapsulation Extended Community from outgoing messages." TestRFC9012ConfiguredEncapsulationECEgress now configures the real bgp-filter-community plugin over an RPC pipe, names bgp-filter-community:egress in the destination's export chain, and gives the destination an export policy compiled by policychain.Compile with WithLibrary, as bgp/config compileLibraryChain does. The peer-chain egress step sends the route through filter-update to evaluateCommunityFilter, whose egress member runs egressFilter -> applyEgressFilter, and the returned operations are applied by genericCommunityHandler during the real ForwardUpdate. Every assertion is byte-identical: both Encapsulation ECs are present at source dispatch, and the remove case requires the socket bytes and the downstream receipt to carry only the RT with ORIGIN, AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP and NLRI unchanged; the populated no-match destination receives both original values. The dropped require.Len(orderedEgressSteps, 1) counted a deleted filterapi registration. The discrimination record, re-taken in 5a77ebfd7e, observed both polarities red with genericCommunityHandler disabled. This proves configurable outgoing filtering, not a default-EBGP behaviour.
